signals.title: GitHub resolved a run-date disruption affecting login and release-asset downloads
signals.title_zh: GitHub 解决了运行日内影响登录与 Release Asset 下载的服务中断
signals.summary: GitHub Status recorded a disruption beginning at 21:39 UTC on August 12 (05:39 Asia/Shanghai on August 13) affecting login and release-asset downloads; GitHub identified the root cause, mitigated the errors, and marked the incident resolved at 22:56 UTC.
signals.summary_zh: GitHub Status 记录了一次始于 8 月 12 日 21:39 UTC（上海时间 8 月 13 日 05:39）的服务中断，影响登录与 Release Asset 下载；GitHub 随后识别根因、实施缓解，并于 22:56 UTC 标记为已解决。

signals.title: Codex unifies turn input admission into atomic start-or-steer routing
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Turn 输入接纳统一为原子化 Start-or-Steer 路由
signals.summary: Codex introduced a typed TurnInputRequest path that atomically starts a turn, steers an active turn, or declines input with a specific reason; app-server turn/start can steer an active regular turn and incompatible schemas or non-steerable states are rejected without applying settings or enqueuing input.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 引入类型化 TurnInputRequest 路径，以原子方式启动 Turn、Steer 活动 Turn，或带明确原因拒绝输入；app-server 的 turn/start 可 Steer 活动常规 Turn，而不兼容 Schema 或不可 Steer 状态会在不应用设置、不入队输入的情况下被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex extends plugin measurement to remote and background execution with bounded private sidecars
signals.title_zh: Codex 将插件度量扩展到远程与后台执行，并使用有界私有 Sidecar
signals.summary: A same-mechanism sequence of Codex changes keeps plugin measurement alive for background commands, finalizes late completions exactly once, and extends collection to remote executors using executor-native owner-private temporary directories, bounded streamed output, validation, and cleanup.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 一组同机制变更使插件度量在后台命令结束前持续有效，对晚到完成事件只收口一次，并扩展到远程执行器：使用执行器原生的仅所有者可访问临时目录、有界流式输出、校验与清理。

signals.title: Codex makes code-mode session recovery generation-aware after gRPC host restarts
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 gRPC Host 重启后实现具备 Generation 语义的 Code Mode 会话恢复
signals.summary: Codex now reopens cached code-mode sessions after a gRPC host stops, serializes concurrent reconnection attempts, scopes cell IDs to the new host generation, coordinates shutdown, and rejects stale wait or terminate requests.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会在 gRPC Host 停止后重新打开缓存的 Code Mode 会话，串行化并发重连尝试，将 Cell ID 绑定到新的 Host Generation，协调关闭过程，并拒绝过期的 wait 或 terminate 请求。

signals.title: Codex adds constrained dynamic HTTP header helpers for local MCP servers
signals.title_zh: Codex 为本地 MCP Server 增加受约束的动态 HTTP Header Helper
signals.summary: Local streamable-HTTP MCP servers can obtain connection-scoped headers from a configured helper command; Codex constrains the mechanism with origin isolation, redirect blocking, reserved and duplicate-header rejection, execution/output limits, managed validation, and command redaction.
signals.summary_zh: 本地 Streamable HTTP MCP Server 可通过配置的 Helper Command 获取连接级 Header；Codex 同时施加 Origin 隔离、禁止重定向、保留/重复 Header 拒绝、执行与输出上限、Managed 校验以及命令脱敏。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.229 hardens remote and self-hosted execution paths
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.229 强化远程与自托管执行链路
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.229 adds resumable Remote Control documentation, server-supplied hooks for self-hosted runners and SSE keepalives for long thinking pauses, while also making missing Git credentials fail fast, requiring explicit Windows self-hosted base directories, tightening sandbox network parsing, and stopping dangerous git flags from auto-approval.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.229 增加 Remote Control 最近会话恢复说明、自托管 Runner 的服务端 Hook 与长思考间隔 SSE Keepalive；同时让缺失 Git 凭据快速失败、要求 Windows 自托管 Runner 显式指定 Base Directory、收紧 Sandbox 网络地址解析，并取消危险 Git Flag 的自动批准。

signals.title: Google ADK moves recalled memory into turn-scoped context to protect reusable cache identity
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将召回记忆移入 Turn 级上下文以保护可复用 Cache Identity
signals.summary: ADK changed PreloadMemoryTool so recalled memory is inserted into the current request's trailing user-context batch rather than the system instruction, preventing one query's memory from destabilizing explicit-cache identity or persisting into reusable prefixes.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修改 PreloadMemoryTool，将召回记忆放入当前请求末尾的 User Context Batch，而不是 System Instruction，从而避免某次查询的记忆破坏 Explicit Cache Identity 或滞留在可复用前缀中。

signals.title: Google ADK repairs HITL resume by restoring transfer-to-agent capability
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 通过恢复 Transfer-to-Agent 能力修复 HITL Resume
signals.summary: ADK fixed human-in-the-loop confirmation resume by injecting the transfer_to_agent tool when the resumed flow requires it, preserving the agent handoff capability across the pause/resume boundary.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复 Human-in-the-Loop 确认后的 Resume 流程：在恢复后的流程需要时注入 transfer_to_agent 工具，使 Agent Handoff 能力跨越暂停/恢复边界继续存在。

signals.title: Google ADK makes pre-metric agent crashes fail evaluations instead of yielding empty success
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将指标执行前的 Agent Crash 视为评测失败而非空成功
signals.summary: ADK now fails an evaluation when an agent crashes before any metric runs, closing a correctness gap where infrastructure or agent failure could otherwise leave an evaluation without meaningful metric evidence.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在会在 Agent 于任何 Metric 执行前崩溃时直接判定 Evaluation 失败，关闭了基础设施或 Agent 故障可能留下‘无有效指标证据’的正确性缺口。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds Apigee completion HTTP timeouts and redirects
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Apigee Completion HTTP 请求设置有界超时与重定向
signals.summary: ADK added explicit bounds to the Apigee completions HTTP client for request timeout and redirect behavior, reducing the chance that external inference transport can wait or follow redirects without a defined bound.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 为 Apigee Completions HTTP Client 增加明确的请求超时与重定向边界，降低外部推理传输在没有定义边界的情况下长时间等待或跟随重定向的风险。
